description: This is a Java class named 'Criteria' that serves as a model for specifying search or query criteria, including fields for pagination ('startIndex', 'maxCount'), identification ('code'), and sorting order ('orderBy').

classes.name: Criteria
classes.description: A Java class representing search criteria with fields for pagination, identification code, and order by option.

methods.name: getMaxCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of results to retrieve.

methods.name: setMaxCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of results to retrieve.

methods.name: getStartIndex
methods.description: Returns the starting index for results pagination.

methods.name: setStartIndex
methods.description: Sets the starting index for results pagination.

methods.name: setOrderBy
methods.description: Sets the ordering preference (ascending or descending).

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Returns the current order by setting.
